description:
Keane Mahony Smith are delighted to bring to the market No. 5 Shangort Park, a three bedroom semi-detached home situated within a mature and well-established residential development in the popular Knocknacarra area. Set within a mature leafy setting, Shangort Park benefits from an abundance of established trees throughout the communal green areas, creating an attractive and pleasant environment for residents.

Built in 1991 and extending to approximately 99 sq.m (1,066 sq.ft), the property offers well-proportioned accommodation over two floors and provides an excellent opportunity for a new owner to modernise and create a home to their own taste and requirements.

The ground floor comprises; entrance hallway, sitting room and an open plan kitchen/dining room. Upstairs, there are three bedrooms, including a master bedroom with walk-in robe and ensuite, a further double bedroom and a single bedroom, together with the main family bathroom. All bedrooms benefit from built-in wardrobes, providing excellent storage throughout.

The property is in need of modernisation; however, its spacious layout, excellent bedroom accommodation and mature leafy setting provide an excellent foundation for the purchaser to put their own stamp on the property and create a modern family home.

The property benefits from oil-fired central heating, double-glazed windows and a C BER rating. Externally, there are private garden areas together with off-street parking.

The location is highly convenient, with a wide range of amenities available close by in Knocknacarra, including schools, shops, supermarkets, sporting facilities and recreational amenities. Salthill and Galway City Centre are also within easy reach, while the area is well served by public transport and provides convenient access to the wider city and surrounding areas.

Viewing is highly recommended through Keane Mahony Smith offices.
